facts.claim: Silver Nova (Silversea Cruises): Entered service 2023; 54,700 GT; 730 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 244 m length; Nova class.
Silver Nova is a luxury cruise ship, the 12th ship in service with Silversea Cruises.
Nova is the first ship in the company's new Evolution-class, and designed with the intent of environmentally friendly cruising.

catalogSpecs.description: Nova-class; cruise ship operated by its listed cruise line; entered service 2023; 54,700 GT; approx. 730 guests at double occupancy.
